subject: [AMBER] Printing X Y Z coordinates of selected atom or group of atoms in cpptraj

messages.author: Md Fulbabu Sk
messages.body:
Hi AMBER Community,
I would like to calculate the Z-position of a selected residue throughout
the trajectory. Is there a way, such as using a cpptraj command, to
calculate this and print it to a text file for each frame of the MD
trajectory? I'm interested in obtaining the X, Y, Z coordinates of a
selected atom (or the average coordinates of a selected group of atoms).
Thanks
Fulbabu

messages.author: Dickson, Callum
messages.body:
Hi Fulbabu,
You can use the "vector" command in cpptraj.
For example, here would be the command for residue 1:
vector c0 :1 :1 out c0.out
This will give you the x,y,z coords for residue 1 per frame into c0.out.
Best,
Callum

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
Slight modification; do 'vector center <mask>' - that will give you
the center of mass of the atoms selected by <mask>.
-Dan
